title: Mitch McConnell Discharged From Rehabilitation Facility After Fall
summary: US Senator Mitch McConnell has been discharged from a rehabilitation facility after suffering a fall in June. He will recover at home and continue to work remotely. The discharge comes after McConnell's office confirmed he had been treated for a non-life-threatening injury. The exact nature of the injury was not specified. McConnell's office said he would resume his Senate duties once he is fully recovered.
summary_points: Mitch McConnell suffered a fall in June and was subsequently discharged from a rehabilitation facility
The discharge comes after McConnell's office confirmed he had been treated for a non-life-threatening injury
McConnell will recover at home and continue to work remotely
The exact nature of the injury was not specified by McConnell's office
